items.title: Designing geo-segmented AWS Cloud WAN with service insertion
items.summary: Design an AWS Cloud WAN network that keeps regional traffic in-region for data residency while running centralized security inspection across geographies. This deployable four-segment, multi-Region reference architecture combines geo-restricted segments with Network Function Groups, covering dual-hop versus single-hop trade-offs and the key NFG constraints.
items.creator: Abhishek Kumar
